title: The Bridge Troll's Toll
story: Grumblegut the Troll blocks the only bridge to the castle. "25 silver pieces, or you shall not pass!" he bellows. Mr 6 checks his three pouches: one holds 6 silver pieces, one holds 9, and one holds 7.
question: How many more silver pieces does Mr 6 need to pay the toll?
hint: First add up all his silver: 6 + 9 + 7. Then figure out how far that is from 25.
victory: Mr 6 is 3 pieces short — so instead he challenges Grumblegut to a counting contest and wins! The troll laughs so hard he waves Mr 6 across for free.
